dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: I've gone over the test data. The Shutterflash lens didn't just meet the theoretical specs — it actually outperformed them, with capture precision nearly flawless!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: With all this valuable performance data, new ideas are already flowing! I can practically see the next generation's design forming in my head!

dialogues.speaker: Ninette
dialogues.text: The n—next generation? But, Master... we only just completed the tests for this version...

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: I've got to write this down before the ideas slip away! Ninette, hurry, my notebook, quick!

dialogues.speaker: Ninette
dialogues.text: Then... please take this special Kamera with the Shutterflash lens. I'll be counting on you to handle it!

dialogues.speaker: Ninette
dialogues.text: Please take some photos of your friends. Try to capture their most natural, expressive moments!
